CONTROL_TOKEN.description: Optional, only for the cf-orbs CLI (status, logs, doctor). Leave it empty for a no-CLI install; the CLI can set it later.

AMP_ORB_PROVIDER_TOKEN.description: Your Amp provider token (`aop_live_…`) from Amp Settings → Orbs → Add Provider. Paste the one you made there; the provider starts on its own after the deploy.
